name: calcium lactate + xylitol
uses: Spray after meals and feedings. Don’t forget to brush kid's teeth for the best results! It’s fluoride-free, preservative-free, and safe to swallow when used as directed! Apply the spray on the kiddo's teeth surface to form a protective coating. • Do not spit the spray out. • Do not rinse with water after spray. This spray is not intend to replace brushing or flossing.
otcwarn: Warnings: Avoid spraying in eyes. In case of contact, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor or pharmacist if you have an allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients.
